description: Open-Motion console firmware (STM32H743VI): laser/TEC/trigger control, FPGA configuration, USB CDC command interface; runs from the secure bootloader's application slot.

components.name: jsmn
components.description: JSON tokenizer (jsmn.c/jsmn.h) from https://github.com/zserge/jsmn, built without JSMN_STRICT. The in-tree copy predates the first upstream release (v1.0.0): it is closest to upstream commit cf38b7d (2014-11-17) and is locally modified (extra "reserved" argument on jsmn_init/jsmn_parse).

properties.name: openwater:local-changes

components.name: openmotion-safety-fpga

components.name: SHA-256 (Core/Src/sha256.c)
components.description: First-party software SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) used by fpga_attest.c to hash the FPGA configuration pages; the STM32H7 HASH peripheral is not enabled in this CubeMX configuration. Not third-party code: recorded here because the firmware's integrity check depends on it.

properties.name: openwater:verification
properties.value: host_tests/test_sha256.c: FIPS 180-4 example vectors (empty, abc, 448-bit, 896-bit, one million 'a') and streaming equivalence
